subject: mathematics
concept: Sharing a quantity in a given ratio
source_inspiration: adapted from Singapore Model Method (bar modeling) principles — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student divides a set of virtual objects into ratio-sized groups and counts each share
exercise.pictorial: Student uses a bar model split into ratio parts to divide a total quantity
exercise.abstract: Student calculates each share when a total is divided in a given ratio

misconception_flags: divides the total by the number of ratio terms instead of the sum of the parts

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
